verdict.rationale: Recurly's involuntary-churn docs list Account Updater, Expired Card Management, and backup payment methods. They also say customers can designate a backup payment method so service continues automatically if the primary payment fails. Recurly Engage adds payment-failure flows with in-app prompts that push users to update their payment details. Missing for 10: any detail on how Account Updater works (which card networks, how often it runs), explicit evidence of a hosted update-payment page as opposed to in-app prompts, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
